studio.title: Fractal Studio
studio.subtitle: Explore mathematical maps, Julia sets, axis transitions and safe custom orbit programs; export the current composition as a reproducible PNG.

modeNotes.map: Explore any built-in two-dimensional map in the parameter plane.
modeNotes.julia: Render the dynamical plane for a fixed complex constant c.
modeNotes.transitionPair: Take a two-dimensional slice between two axis-lifted formulas.
modeNotes.transitionMulti: Blend a weighted schedule of up to four axis-lifted formulas into one image.
modeNotes.formula: Use the bounded Orbit Program DSL; no native code is compiled in the browser or service.
modeNotes.sequence: Repeat several safe formulas for specified iteration spans. This changes the orbit itself, not only the output color.

studio.juliaSelectInstruction: Use the left parameter plane to choose c. Both views pan and zoom independently; only the right Julia plane is exported.
studio.juliaPickerHint: Click a point to choose c; drag or zoom to inspect the parameter plane.
studio.juliaOutputHint: The Julia set for the selected c. This viewport is the exported image.
studio.formulaHint: Variables z and c are complex. Supported functions include sin, cos, tan, exp, log, sqrt, abs, conj, sinh, cosh and tanh. Formula length and evaluation cost are bounded by Compute.
studio.sequenceHint: Steps repeat in order. A span of 3 applies that formula for three iterations before advancing.
studio.transitionHint: Only formulas with a defined axis lift are offered. This is a two-dimensional result and exports exactly like the ordinary map.
studio.centerAlwaysVisible: center is retained in every recipe

canvas.selectHint: click: choose c · drag: pan · wheel: zoom

studio.compositionHint: The preview uses the same aspect ratio as the export frame. Output dimensions are bounded to 64–4096 px per side.
studio.customGradientHint: Custom gradients use direct coloring. Stop positions, repeat behavior, interior and invalid colors are saved in the recipe.

direct.name: Direct
direct.description: Map the raw metric directly to color. Fast and faithful, but dense regions can bunch into a narrow color range.

eq_full.name: Full histogram equalization
eq_full.description: Redistribute values using the whole image histogram. Reveals global structure but the palette can shift when the viewport changes.

eq_center.name: Center-weighted equalization
eq_center.description: Equalize with more influence from the central region. Useful while navigating a focal structure and less dominated by outer pixels.

escape.name: Escape time
escape.description: Color by how quickly the orbit leaves the bailout radius; the standard set boundary view.

min_abs.name: Minimum magnitude
min_abs.description: Record the closest approach to the origin across the orbit, exposing internal filaments.

max_abs.name: Maximum magnitude
max_abs.description: Record the greatest orbit magnitude, emphasizing growth and outer-field structure.

envelope.name: Orbit envelope
envelope.description: Summarize the orbit's radial envelope to reveal broader dynamical texture.

min_pairwise_dist.name: Minimum pairwise distance
min_pairwise_dist.description: Measure near-recurrence between sampled orbit points. More expensive and controlled by the pairwise cap.

mandel_ship_agree.name: Mandelbrot / Ship agreement
mandel_ship_agree.description: Compare two built-in orbit classifications to visualize where their behavior agrees.

mandelbrot.name: Mandelbrot
mandelbrot.description: The canonical quadratic map z² + c and the reference point for the family.

tricorn.name: Tricorn
tricorn.description: A conjugated quadratic map with threefold, reflection-rich geometry.

burning_ship.name: Burning Ship
burning_ship.description: Folds both complex components before iteration, producing sharp hulls and flame-like detail.

celtic.name: Celtic
celtic.description: A folded quadratic variant with interlocking bands and knot-like boundaries.

heart.name: Heart
heart.description: A directional fold that produces rounded lobes and asymmetric heart-like regions.

buffalo.name: Buffalo
buffalo.description: A two-axis folded family with branching silhouettes and dense boundary texture.

perp_buffalo.name: Perpendicular Buffalo
perp_buffalo.description: A perpendicular fold of the Buffalo family with altered reflection symmetry.

celtic_ship.name: Celtic Ship
celtic_ship.description: Combines Celtic and Burning Ship folds into layered, angular coastlines.

mandelceltic.name: Mandelceltic
mandelceltic.description: A Mandelbrot–Celtic hybrid that keeps the main cardioid context while folding local detail.

perp_ship.name: Perpendicular Ship
perp_ship.description: A perpendicular Burning Ship fold with distinct directional ridges.

sin_z.name: Sine map
sin_z.description: Uses the complex sine function in the orbit, creating periodic lobes across the plane.

cos_z.name: Cosine map
cos_z.description: Uses complex cosine dynamics, with repeating bands and strong imaginary-axis growth.

exp_z.name: Exponential map
exp_z.description: Complex exponential dynamics produce rapidly growing, repeating structures.

sinh_z.name: Hyperbolic sine
sinh_z.description: Hyperbolic sine dynamics combine exponential growth with odd symmetry.

cosh_z.name: Hyperbolic cosine
cosh_z.description: Hyperbolic cosine dynamics combine exponential growth with even symmetry.

tan_z.name: Tangent map
tan_z.description: Complex tangent introduces poles and repeating domains with abrupt boundaries.

classic_cos.name: Classic cosine
classic_cos.description: Continuous cosine channels cycle through deep blue, amber and pale highlights.
classic_cos.cost: low cost; periodic colors can hide absolute iteration differences.

mod17.name: Modulo 17
mod17.description: A deliberately discrete 17-step palette that exposes iteration bands.
mod17.bestFor: teaching escape counts and spotting band boundaries.
mod17.cost: very clear bands, but little smooth tonal depth.

hsv_wheel.name: HSV wheel
hsv_wheel.description: Cycles through the full hue wheel at near-constant saturation.
hsv_wheel.bestFor: periodic metrics and visually separating adjacent bands.
hsv_wheel.cost: hue changes are not perceptually uniform in brightness.

tri765.name: Triangular 765
tri765.description: A long triangular RGB cycle with crisp rises and falls in each channel.
tri765.bestFor: high-frequency iteration structure and retro scientific plots.
tri765.cost: strong contrast may dominate subtle geometry.

grayscale.name: Grayscale
grayscale.description: A neutral black-to-white ramp with no hue encoding.
grayscale.bestFor: shape study, print, masks and later compositing.
grayscale.cost: lowest visual ambiguity, but cannot separate multiple value classes by hue.

hs_rainbow.name: Hidden-structure rainbow
hs_rainbow.description: A broad scientific rainbow tuned for non-escape orbit fields.
hs_rainbow.bestFor: minimum magnitude, envelope and hidden-structure metrics.
hs_rainbow.cost: colorful and legible, though not luminance-uniform.

inferno.name: Inferno
inferno.description: A dark perceptual ramp through violet, red, orange and pale yellow.
inferno.bestFor: fine structure on dark backgrounds and monotonic magnitude reading.
inferno.cost: high values receive strong visual emphasis.

viridis.name: Viridis
viridis.description: A perceptual violet-blue-green-yellow ramp with steadily increasing lightness.
viridis.bestFor: measurement-oriented images and broad value ranges.
viridis.cost: restrained mood; cyclic boundaries are less obvious.

twilight.name: Twilight
twilight.description: A cyclic light–violet–navy–magenta palette whose ends meet smoothly.
twilight.bestFor: phase-like or repeating values without a visible seam.
twilight.cost: lightness reverses, so it is not ideal for strictly ordered magnitude.

ember_blue.name: Ember blue
ember_blue.description: A project palette moving from midnight blue through cyan to amber-white.
ember_blue.bestFor: cold-to-hot contrast and finished artwork with a restrained identity.
ember_blue.cost: artistic contrast is stronger than neutral measurement.

spectral1530.name: Spectral 1530
spectral1530.description: A long multi-hue spectral cycle designed to keep many adjacent bands distinct.
spectral1530.bestFor: deep iteration ranges and dense band comparison.
spectral1530.cost: many hues can make global ordering harder to read.
